params.name: printSettings
params.description: Current print settings, saved by the command

overloads.semanticRole: Saves the current 4D print settings (layout and print parameters, including platform-specific driver settings) into printSettings so they can be persisted and restored later via BLOB to print settings; returns 1 on success or 0 if no printer is currently selected.

constraints: Must be used in conjunction with BLOB to print settings, which reloads a BLOB previously produced by this command; the generated BLOB must not be modified by programming.

The printSettings BLOB mixes cross-platform and platform-specific (driver-dependent) data; sharing one BLOB between Windows and macOS can lose platform-specific parts, so it is recommended to keep separate BLOBs per platform in heterogeneous environments.
